info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking It Management System Deployment Review-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of deployment reviews for banking IT management systems. It allows users to initiate a review process for a specific system deployment identified by its unique ID. Typical consumers of this API include IT teams and deployment managers who are involved in evaluating the effectiveness and compliance of the deployment. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure thorough oversight and continuous improvement of their deployment processes.

post.summary: Submit a review for the system deployment.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific system deployment identified by RES-100045. Use this feature to provide feedback regarding the deployment's performance and usability.
